title: AXI Read Scoreboard: Allocate, Wait, Retire
description: Three accepted AR requests overlap in flight; inspect each phase to see when a master allocates tracking state and when an accepted RLAST beat retires it.
labels: AR handshake allocates an accepted request
RID selects the per-ID issue-order queue
RVALID && RREADY && RLAST retires the burst

phases.name: AR accepted
phases.description: ARVALID and ARREADY are HIGH at the accepting edge. The master records ID 0, address, length, destination, and return context.

phases.name: Outstanding
phases.description: Read A remains in the scoreboard while the target works. Other AR requests can be accepted during this window.

phases.name: RLAST accepted
phases.description: The final R beat for RID 0 handshakes. The master can now retire Read A's issue-order entry.

phases.name: AR accepted
phases.description: A second address is accepted before Read A completes, so two reads are now outstanding.

phases.name: Outstanding
phases.description: Read B uses a different ID and may complete before or after A if the target and interconnect support reordering.

phases.name: RLAST accepted
phases.description: The accepted final beat for RID 1 releases Read B's tracking entry.

phases.name: AR accepted
phases.description: Read C reuses ID 0 while Read A is outstanding. Reusing an ID is legal, but its read response must remain behind A's response in that ID's issue order.

phases.name: Outstanding
phases.description: The scoreboard keeps a queue for ID 0, preserving A before C while independently tracking ID 1.

phases.name: RLAST accepted
phases.description: Read C retires only when its own final R transfer is accepted; seeing RID 0 earlier for Read A did not retire both transactions.

annotations.message: Outstanding depth is a configured interface capability, not the number of distinct ID values.
Same-ID reuse consumes another entry and adds an ordering obligation; it does not create a unique-ID violation.
For writes, the analogous retirement event is an accepted B response.
